objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the patient presenting with intense itching and development of 'red bumps' on the thigh and other parts of the body.
chief_complaint: Intense itching on the right thigh

fragments.text: The patient presents with intense itching of his right thigh region for the past few days. He also mentions the recent formation of ‘red bumps’ in the same area. The patient has recently attended a business conference in Miami. He has a past medical history of hypertension, diabetes type 2, and hyperlipidemia. The patient’s medication regimen includes enalapril, metformin, and atorvastatin. He denies any history of smoking or drinking.
Itching also present on the left leg and right forearm
Hypertension, Diabetes Type 2, Hyperlipidemia. Medications: Enalapril, Metformin, Atorvastatin.
Non-smoker, does not consume alcohol. Recently traveled to Miami for a business conference.
Denies fever, weight loss, recent illnesses, or other skin conditions.

exam_leaves.text: A linear line with 3 red papules noted along the medial aspect of the right thigh. Small rows of bumps observed on his left leg and right forearm.
Excoriations present in the regions with the red bumps, indicative of significant scratching.

test_leaves.text: No evidence of mites or eggs, ruling out scabies.
